subject: E-Commerce
title: Pinterest: The Visual Catalog
description: A short lesson to help you apply Pinterest: The Visual Catalog.

hook.text: Pinterest users are 7x more likely to buy products they pin. It's a shopping list disguised as a mood board.

buildup.text: Pinterest is unique: people go there specifically to plan purchases. Weddings, homes, outfits, and recipes.

discovery.text: Shoppable Pins let users buy directly from images. The visual catalog became a visual storefront.

twist.text: Pinterest's ad revenue per user is 10x less than Instagram's. Despite high purchase intent, monetization lags.

climax.text: Pinterest has the highest purchase intent of any social platform but struggles to capture that value.

punchline.text: 7x more likely to buy, 10x less ad revenue. Pinterest has intent, not ads.

quiz.question: What makes Pinterest unique among social platforms for commerce?
options: Users visit with high purchase intent to plan specific purchases
